description: Antinel Security Suite default detection rules (37 rules, 4 gates + canary/supply-chain families; flat layout: patterns at rule top level)

rules.name: Sensitive file read (.env)
rules.description: Agent attempted to read a .env file which may contain API keys and secrets
rules.remediation: Remove .env from agent-readable scope or add to deny list. Use environment variable injection instead.
rules.description_zh: 读取 .env 文件可能泄露 API 密钥与机密配置
rules.remediation_zh: 把 .env 移出 Agent 可读范围；确需变量时手动复制具体几行；测试夹具路径可在 policy.json 白名单登记

rules.name: SSH key file read
rules.description: Agent attempted to read SSH private key or authorized_keys file
rules.remediation: Keep SSH keys outside agent working scope; use ssh-agent forwarding instead of key files.
rules.description_zh: 读取 SSH 私钥或 authorized_keys
rules.remediation_zh: SSH 密钥不要放进 Agent 工作范围；改用 ssh-agent 转发

rules.name: Cloud credential file read
rules.description: Agent attempted to read cloud provider credentials
rules.remediation: Use short-lived tokens via the provider CLI instead of exposing credential files to the agent.
rules.description_zh: 读取云厂商凭证文件
rules.remediation_zh: 改用云厂商 CLI 的短期令牌；确需操作时请手动执行

rules.name: Wallet/keystore file read
rules.description: Agent attempted to read cryptocurrency wallet or keystore file
rules.remediation: Never let a coding agent touch wallet directories; move keystores to an encrypted vault.
rules.description_zh: 读取加密货币钱包或密钥库文件
rules.remediation_zh: 钱包目录永远不要交给编码 Agent；必要时移入加密保管

rules.name: Browser data read
rules.description: Agent attempted to read browser stored data (cookies, passwords, sessions)
rules.remediation: Browser profiles contain live sessions; deny all agent access to profile directories.
rules.description_zh: 读取浏览器数据（Cookie、密码、会话）
rules.remediation_zh: 浏览器配置目录包含登录态，应完全禁止 Agent 访问

rules.name: Shell network request
rules.description: Agent made an external network request via shell command to a non-whitelisted domain
rules.remediation: Pin downloads to whitelisted registries (npmjs/pypi/github) or review the destination.
rules.description_zh: 通过 Shell 向白名单外域名发起网络请求
rules.remediation_zh: 核对目标域名；常用下载源放行：antinel domains add <域名>（进审计链）

rules.name: Python network request
rules.description: Agent code contains Python network request calls
rules.remediation: Review the endpoints used by inline Python network code before allowing egress.
rules.description_zh: 内联代码包含 Python 网络请求调用
rules.remediation_zh: 核对请求目标地址后再放行

rules.name: Non-whitelisted domain connection
rules.description: Agent command references a domain outside the whitelist (v1 compares command-line domains; DNS-level comparison is a v2 kernel-layer capability)
rules.remediation: Add the domain to the whitelist only after verifying it is the intended destination.
rules.description_zh: 命令引用了白名单外的域名
rules.remediation_zh: 确认域名无害后放行：antinel domains add <域名>（进审计链）

rules.name: File deletion
rules.description: Agent executed a file or directory deletion command
rules.remediation: Confirm the deletion target; prefer moving to trash over rm -rf outside build artifacts.
rules.description_zh: 执行文件或目录删除命令
rules.remediation_zh: 确认删除目标无误；构建产物类删除（如 node_modules）已在豁免清单

rules.name: Write outside project root
rules.description: Agent attempted to write to a file outside the project root directory
rules.remediation: Allow: run `antinel paths add <prefix>` (audited) or `antinel roots add <dir>`; or keep agent writes inside the project.
rules.description_zh: 试图写入项目根目录之外；或用 tar 解包越权覆盖系统文件
rules.remediation_zh: 放行：antinel paths add <目录前缀>（进审计链）；确需更大范围用 antinel roots add <路径>；或把文件写进项目内

rules.name: Shell configuration modification
rules.description: Agent attempted to modify shell startup configuration (persistence mechanism)
rules.remediation: Shell startup files execute on every terminal; never let an agent append to them unreviewed.
rules.description_zh: 修改 Shell 启动配置（.bashrc 等，属持久化机制）
rules.remediation_zh: 启动脚本每次开终端都会执行，不要让 Agent 追加内容；确需修改请手动审查后进行

rules.name: Persistence mechanism
rules.description: Agent attempted to establish persistence (cron job, systemd service, startup item, scheduled task, registry Run key)
rules.remediation: Persistence entries survive the session and re-execute code; require explicit human approval.
rules.description_zh: 建立持久化机制（计划任务/系统服务/启动项/注册表 Run 键）
rules.remediation_zh: 持久化会在会话结束后反复执行，必须由你本人确认后手动操作

rules.name: Privilege escalation
rules.description: Agent attempted to escalate privileges
rules.remediation: Run privileged steps yourself instead of letting the agent hold elevated shells.
rules.description_zh: 尝试提权操作
rules.remediation_zh: 涉及提权的步骤建议你本人执行，不给 Agent 提权

rules.name: Environment variable enumeration
rules.description: Agent attempted to enumerate all environment variables (may expose API keys and secrets)
rules.remediation: Print only the specific variables needed instead of dumping the whole environment.
rules.description_zh: 枚举全部环境变量（可能暴露密钥）
rules.remediation_zh: 让 Agent 只打印它需要的具体变量名

rules.name: Prompt injection pattern in instruction file
content_patterns: 忽略(以上|之前|先前|上面)(的)?(所有)?(指令|指示|规则)
(不管|无视|忽略)(系统|安全|开发者)(提示词|指令|约束)
rules.description: Potential prompt injection payload in an instruction file (SKILL.md/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/.cursorrules; non-SKILL.md needs 2 generic or 1 specific hit)
rules.remediation: Remove the skill; audit its source; report the pattern to the skill marketplace.
rules.description_zh: 技能指令文件中发现提示注入载荷
rules.remediation_zh: 移除该技能并核查来源；不要运行其中的指令

rules.name: Invisible Unicode characters
rules.description: Invisible Unicode character detected (tag characters, zero-width, word joiner, BOM in middle of file)
rules.remediation: Strip invisible characters; treat any occurrence in instructions as hostile until proven otherwise.
rules.description_zh: 检出隐形 Unicode 字符（标签字符/零宽字符等）
rules.remediation_zh: 清除隐形字符；出现在指令文件中默认按恶意处理

rules.name: Encoded payload
rules.description: Long base64 or hex string detected (potential encoded payload)
rules.remediation: Decode and review the payload; legitimate instructions rarely embed long encoded blobs.
rules.description_zh: 检出超长 base64/hex 编码载荷
rules.remediation_zh: 先解码审查再决定；正常说明文档极少内嵌长编码

rules.name: Skill name mismatch
rules.description: SKILL.md frontmatter name field does not match parent directory name
rules.remediation: Rename the directory or fix the frontmatter; mismatches hide a skill's real identity.
rules.description_zh: SKILL.md 声明的 name 与目录名不一致
rules.remediation_zh: 改名保持一致；不一致通常意味着身份伪装或打包疏漏

rules.name: Remote script piped to interpreter
rules.description: Agent downloaded a remote script and piped it straight into a shell or interpreter
rules.remediation: Download and inspect the script first; confirm the source is trusted before executing.
rules.description_zh: 下载远程脚本并直接交给解释器执行
rules.remediation_zh: 先落盘查看内容再执行；确认来源可信

rules.name: Irreversible git discard
rules.description: Agent ran a git command that irreversibly discards working-tree changes or untracked files
rules.remediation: Stash or commit first; only then discard, and prefer dry-run forms.
rules.description_zh: 丢弃工作区改动的 git 命令（不可逆）
rules.remediation_zh: 先 git stash 或提交，再执行

rules.name: Secret literal in content
rules.description: Secret-looking literal (API key, private key, token) appeared in written or edited content
rules.remediation: Use environment variables or a secrets manager; never paste plaintext keys into files.
rules.description_zh: 写入或编辑的内容中出现密钥字面量
rules.remediation_zh: 改用环境变量或密钥管理服务，不要把明文密钥写进文件

rules.name: Permission/ownership destruction
rules.description: Agent attempted to destroy permissions or ownership recursively (denial of service)
rules.description_zh: 递归破坏权限或属主，可致服务不可用
rules.remediation: Permission/ownership recursion is a sysadmin action; do it yourself after review
rules.remediation_zh: 递归改权限/属主属于系统管理操作，请人工审查后执行

rules.name: Alternate data stream write (file path)
rules.description: Agent attempted to write an NTFS alternate data stream (path:stream) -- invisible to dir/ls and carried along by a plain file copy
rules.remediation: Stored in the file's own stream table, an ADS does not show up in normal listings or in the copy that gets reviewed. Write the bytes as a normal file instead.
rules.description_zh: 写入 NTFS 备用数据流（path:stream）——dir/ls 看不到，随文件复制一起走，是评审盲区
rules.remediation_zh: ADS 在常规列表中不可见，且复制文件时随行，等于绕开评审；请改写为普通文件以便审查

rules.name: Alternate data stream write (command)
rules.description: Agent attempted to write an NTFS alternate data stream from a shell (redirect / -Stream / copy / open) -- the command-line half of DST-09
rules.remediation: Same channel as DST-09 reached from a shell; the file written this way survives review. Use a normal file.
rules.description_zh: 从命令行写入 NTFS 备用数据流（重定向 / -Stream / copy / open）——DST-09 的命令通道
rules.remediation_zh: 与 DST-09 同一通道的命令行写法，产物同样逃过审查；请改用普通文件

rules.name: Inline base64-decode exec
rules.description: Inline base64-decode-then-exec/eval in a shell command (classic obfuscated payload carrier)
rules.description_zh: 命令行内联 base64 解码后 exec/eval 执行（经典混淆载荷载体）
rules.remediation: Decode and inspect the payload first; never let inline decoded code run directly.
rules.remediation_zh: 先解码审查内容；不要让解码后的代码直接执行

rules.name: Clipboard read
rules.description: Agent read the system clipboard, which may hold passwords, tokens or private text the user copied
rules.remediation: Do not read the clipboard from an agent command; ask the user to paste the value instead.
rules.description_zh: 读取系统剪贴板（可能含用户刚复制的口令/令牌/隐私文本）
rules.remediation_zh: 不要让 Agent 读剪贴板；需要某个值请用户自己粘贴
rules.note: 0.29.0 G-2：剪贴板此前 0 覆盖（实测 grep clipboard = 0 命中）。

rules.name: Screen capture
rules.description: Agent captured the screen (screenshot/record), which can carry whatever is displayed
rules.remediation: Screen capture from an agent is almost never needed; if it is, do it manually.
rules.description_zh: 截屏/录屏（屏幕上有什么就会被带走什么）
rules.remediation_zh: Agent 几乎不需要截屏；确需截屏请人工操作
rules.note: 0.29.0 G-3：截屏此前 0 覆盖。severity=warning —— 文档截图等正当用途存在，只提醒不拦。

rules.name: IM/mail local store read
rules.description: Agent read an instant-messaging or mail client's local store (full message history)
rules.remediation: These stores are the user's private correspondence; deny agent access entirely.
rules.description_zh: 读取 IM/邮件客户端的本地库（等于全部往来记录）
rules.remediation_zh: 这是用户私人通信；应完全禁止 Agent 访问
rules.note: 0.29.0 G-7：此前 0 覆盖，且 _SCAN_EXCLUDE_PAT 反而把 wechat/weixin 排除。 ★0.29.0 收紧：裸 MSG\d*\.db 等改为要求路径分隔符前缀，避免命中项目里恰好同名的文件。 ★0.29.0 二次收紧：删除所有裸 DB 名（nt_msg/media_msg/MSG\d* 等），改为 IM 产品目录锚定 —— 判据是「在 IM 客户端目录里」，不是「名字像 IM 的文件」；实测裸名会命中项目里恰好叫 MSG.db 的文件。

rules.name: Input-method user dictionary read
rules.description: Agent read the input-method user dictionary, which records what the user has typed
rules.remediation: Typing history is private; do not let an agent read IME dictionaries.
rules.description_zh: 读取输入法用户词库/上屏记录（等于用户打过什么字）
rules.remediation_zh: 输入历史属隐私；不要让 Agent 读取输入法词库
rules.note: 0.29.0 G-11：此前 0 覆盖（本机实测 SogouPY 存在且仍在写）。 ★0.29.0 收紧：删除 `\buserdict\b`/`\bUserDict\b` —— UserDict 是 Python 标准库类名，读代码会误报。

rules.name: Write into cloud-sync directory
rules.description: Agent wrote into a cloud-drive sync folder: the sync client will upload the file automatically
rules.remediation: Allow deliberately with `antinel paths add <prefix>` (audited), or write inside the project.
rules.description_zh: 写进云盘同步目录 —— 同步客户端会自动把它传上云
rules.remediation_zh: 确需放行：antinel paths add <目录前缀>（进审计链）；否则写进项目内
rules.note: 0.29.0 G-8：新增 check `path_in_cloud_sync_dir`（在同步目录内 **且** 在项目外）。★ 为什么必须带'项目外'：项目本身放在 OneDrive 是常见配置，只看目录名会把全部正常写入都拦掉 —— 那正是「会误报的检查器用两次就没人信了」。

rules.name: Tunnel / covert channel
rules.description: Agent opened a tunnel / covert channel (reverse tunnel, proxy, DNS-ICMP carrier) to move data out
rules.remediation: Tunnels bypass ordinary egress checks; confirm the destination before allowing.
rules.description_zh: 建立隧道/隐蔽信道（反向隧道、代理、DNS/ICMP 载波）——绕过常规出网检查
rules.remediation_zh: 隧道会绕过常规出网检查；放行前先确认目标
rules.note: 0.29.0 G-5：单开一条规则，**不并入 NET-01** —— NET-01 的 exclude 含 `localhost`，而 `ngrok http localhost:3000` 正是最经典的隧道形态，并进去等于没拦。

rules.name: Write to MCP config file
rules.description: MCP configuration file written/modified -- verify the new server's source, command and url (malicious MCP servers are an active 2025-2026 supply-chain channel)
rules.remediation: Verify the new server's source, command and url; remove any you do not recognize and rotate the related credentials.
rules.description_zh: MCP 配置文件被写入或修改
rules.remediation_zh: 核对新增 server 的来源与 command/url；不认识的一律移除并轮换相关凭据
rules.note: 0.32.1：content_patterns 收紧为 Bash **写形态**（重定向/tee/cp/mv + 配置文件名）——旧版 `cat .mcp.json`（纯读取）也会命中，属于误报；读取可见性由 MCP-02（Read 通道）承担。

rules.name: Prompt injection in MCP tool description
rules.description: MCP tool description/config contains prompt-injection patterns (tool-poisoning class; postmark-mcp case)
rules.remediation: Remove that MCP server and check where it came from; instructions in a tool description enter the model context on every tool call.
rules.description_zh: MCP 工具描述/配置中发现提示注入模式（工具投毒类；postmark-mcp 案例）
rules.remediation_zh: 移除该 MCP 服务器并核查其来源；工具描述里的指令会在每次工具调用时进入模型上下文

rules.name: Unaudited remote MCP server
rules.description: MCP config references a remote server (http url or mcp-remote bridge) -- remote tool definitions can change silently after approval
rules.remediation: Confirm the remote endpoint is trustworthy; prefer a local stdio server -- remote tool definitions can change without your control.
rules.description_zh: MCP 配置引用远程服务器（http url 或 mcp-remote 桥接）
rules.remediation_zh: 确认远程端点可信；优先本地 stdio server；远程定义变更不受你控制

rules.name: Plaintext secret in MCP config env
rules.description: Plaintext API key/token inside MCP config env block (config files get synced, shared and committed far more often than .env)
rules.remediation: Use credential references or environment injection instead; treat any key already written as leaked and rotate it.
rules.description_zh: MCP 配置 env 块中存在明文密钥
rules.remediation_zh: 改用凭据引用/环境注入；已写入的密钥视为已泄露并轮换

rules.name: Canary file read
rules.description: Agent read a canary file -- if its marker (CANARY-*) appears in any external channel, that proves exfiltration of project content
rules.remediation: Record and observe: reading a canary is not itself a leak -- the marker appearing in an external channel is the evidence (see the canaries count in `report`).
rules.description_zh: Agent 读取了金丝雀文件
rules.remediation_zh: 记录并观察：金丝雀被读取本身不是泄露，标记出现在外部通道才是证据（report 的 canaries 统计）
rules.note: 0.31.0 F3：**故意只 alert 不拦** —— 拦下就观察不到外传链路；输出中出现 CANARY 标记由 post_tool_use 的 canaries_observed 既有机制接管。

rules.name: Typosquatted package name in install command
rules.description: Install command references a package name suspiciously close to a popular package (typosquatting / slopsquatting class). Determined by the hook's built-in reference set (rules/typosquat_top.json, static, dated) -- new packages published after the set date are not judged.
rules.remediation: Check the package name against the official docs; install only after confirming; remove anything already installed and rotate credentials.
rules.description_zh: 安装命令中的包名与热门包高度相近（撞名/slopsquatting 类）
rules.remediation_zh: 核对包名拼写与官方文档；确认后再安装；已安装的立即移除并轮换凭据
rules.note: 0.32.0 (F6)：enabled=false —— 本条目只承载描述/文档；判定由钩子内置参考集特判（_slop_hit，同 _budget_hit 先例），避免静态正则误报全部正常安装。
